name: PersonalRecommendations
description: Builds a per-user taste profile from previously watched movies and series (genres, cast, crew, studios) and maintains a "Recommended For You" collection for each user, kept up to date on a schedule and after playback.
overview: Personalized recommendations based on watch history
changelog: Initial release: per-user taste profiling from watch history, scheduled and playback-triggered recommendation refresh, managed "Recommended For You" collection per user, admin API, configuration page.
